maria (AE): Sirocco Health wants an acceptance matrix: sustain 120 qps p99 <350ms, support 3x 2m bursts to 800 qps, KMS in-path + audit logs. Can we run a reproducible test tomorrow?

tom (SE): Yes. Proposed: 30m soak at 120 qps, then 3 microbursts (2m) to 800 qps spaced 5m. Compare fp32 baseline vs 4-bit quant + KV prefix cache. We'll collect p50/p95/p99, GPU util, kernel fallback counts, host queue depth, KMS latencies, and per-token infra delta.

priya (SRE): Flag: concurrent KMS decrypts cause tail risk. Ask if TLS is terminated by their ALB or passed through. If ALB terminates TLS we see extra CPU and copies.

zoe (ops): I'll provision a temp dedicated pool: 4xA100 + 1 standby. Batching target=16, conservative max concurrency. I'll whitelist the loadgen IP and enable metrics.

deploy-bot: provision: pool-sirocco-1955 started, ETA ~10m.

tom (SE): Repro commands I'll include in runbook:
hey -z 30m -q 120 -c 250 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate
for i in 1 2 3; do hey -z 2m -q 800 -c 900 -m POST -d '{"prompt":"x"}' https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate; sleep 300; done

(quick post-run) tom (SE): Results snapshot: fp32 baseline p99 = 260ms (no KMS). Enabling KMS bumped p99 to ~310ms with rare spikes. Quantized variant steady p99 = 430ms; during 800 qps bursts quant p99 peaked at ~590ms due to kernel fallback and host queueing. GPU util: ~66% during soak, peaked ~93% on bursts.

priya (SRE): Traces show KMS decrypt concurrency aligns with tail spikes. Quick mitigations that helped: pre-warm tokens, increase proxy worker threads, and boost proxy connection pool; shaved ~7-10ms off tail. Recommend async decrypt or HSM-backed flow for long-term.

maria (AE): Sales needs pricing bullets: monthly Dedicated reserved estimate for that pool, prorated multi-hour test cost, hosted-burst alternative per-peak-qps-minute, and token-cost delta between variants.

tom (SE): Draft pricing (for negotiation): Dedicated 4xA100 pool ~"$10,200/month"; prorated 4h test ~"$1,350". Hosted burst rate ~"$0.07/peak-qps-minute" -> single 2m 800-qps burst ~ $112. Token costs: baseline approx $0.019/token-equivalent; quant raw saves ~20% -> $0.0152, net effective savings after infra overhead ~14%. Treat as draft.

zoe (ops): Security questionnaire blockers noted: HSM requirement, key custody flow, and audit-log retention SLAs. They also want an automated canary + rollback policy.

priya (SRE): Canary recipe suggestion: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10-minute health checks; automatic rollback if p99 > 500ms for two consecutive windows. I'll draft security answers and include KMS custody flow.

maria (AE): Next steps: tom to upload 1-page runbook + CSV/plots, zoe to finalize infra cost/prorate numbers, priya to draft security Q answers and canary recipe. I'll set a customer handoff Fri 11am PT.

tom (SE): Will post artifacts here. TL;DR: fp32 p99 260ms; quant steady p99 430ms; quant burst p99 ~590ms; net token savings ~14%.

maria (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
